title: BGB-43395 Alone or as Part of Combination Therapies in Participants With Breast Cancer and Other Advanced Solid Tumors

rules.rule_text: Age at least 18 years
rules.source_text: Minimum age: 18 Years

rules.rule_text: Phase 1a: Histologically or cytologically confirmed advanced, metastatic, or unresectable solid tumor with CDK4 dependency (HR+ breast cancer, ovarian cancer, endometrial cancer, NSCLC, or others)
rules.source_text: Phase 1a (Dose Escalation): Participants with histologically or cytologically confirmed advanced, metastatic, or unresectable solid tumors associated with dependency on CDK4, including HR+ breast cancer, ovarian cancer, endometrial cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, and others.

rules.rule_text: Phase 1a with elacestrant: At least 1 prior line of treatment for advanced/metastatic disease including endocrine therapy and CDK4/6 inhibitor
rules.source_text: For combination with elacestrant, participants must have received at least 1 prior line of treatment for advanced/metastatic disease including prior endocrine therapy and CDK4/6 inhibitor in either the adjuvant or advanced/metastatic setting.

rules.rule_text: Phase 1a Safety Expansion with fulvestrant: HR+ breast cancer with at least 1 prior line including endocrine therapy and CDK4/6 inhibitor
rules.source_text: Phase 1a Safety Expansion: For combination with fulvestrant in regions where approved and available, participants with HR+ breast cancer must have received at least 1 prior line of treatment including endocrine therapy and a CDK4/6 inhibitor.
rules.applies_if: Phase 1a Safety Expansion with fulvestrant combination

rules.rule_text: Phase 1a Safety Expansion with letrozole: CDK4/6 inhibitor treatment naïve with no prior systemic treatment for advanced disease
rules.source_text: For combination with letrozole, participants must be CDK4/6 inhibitor treatment naïve and have not received any previous systemic treatment for advanced disease.
rules.applies_if: Phase 1a Safety Expansion with letrozole combination

rules.rule_text: Phase 1b: HR+/HER2- breast cancer
rules.source_text: Phase 1b: Participants with HR+/HER2- breast cancer.

rules.rule_text: Phase 1b with fulvestrant: 1-2 lines of therapy for advanced/metastatic disease including endocrine therapy and CDK4/6 inhibitor; up to 2 lines of prior cytotoxic chemotherapy
rules.source_text: For combination with fulvestrant, participants with HR+/HER2- breast cancer enrolled in regions where CDK4/6 inhibitors are approved and available must have received 1-2 lines of therapy for advanced/metastatic disease including endocrine therapy and a CDK4/6 inhibitor. Participants can have received up to 2 lines of prior cytotoxic chemotherapy for advanced disease.

rules.rule_text: Phase 1b with letrozole: CDK4/6 inhibitor treatment naïve with no prior systemic treatment for advanced disease
rules.source_text: For combination cohorts with letrozole, participants must be CDK4/6 inhibitor treatment naïve and have not received any previous systemic treatment for advanced disease.

rules.rule_text: ECOG performance status ≤ 1, stable
rules.source_text: Stable Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status ≤ 1.

rules.rule_text: Female participants with metastatic HR+/HER2- breast cancer must be postmenopausal or receiving ovarian function suppression
rules.source_text: Female participants with metastatic HR+/HER2- breast cancer must be postmenopausal or receiving ovarian function suppression treatment.
rules.applies_if: Female with metastatic HR+/HER2- breast cancer

rules.rule_text: Adequate organ function without symptomatic visceral disease
rules.source_text: Adequate organ function without symptomatic visceral disease.
rules.notes: No specific thresholds provided; clinical judgment required

rules.rule_text: Leptomeningeal disease
rules.source_text: Known leptomeningeal disease or uncontrolled, untreated brain metastases.

rules.rule_text: Uncontrolled, untreated brain metastases
rules.source_text: Known leptomeningeal disease or uncontrolled, untreated brain metastases.

rules.rule_text: Other malignancy ≤ 3 years before first dose except study cancer or locally recurring cancer treated with curative intent
rules.source_text: Any malignancy ≤ 3 years before the first dose of study treatment(s) except for the specific cancer under investigation in this study and any locally recurring cancer that has been treated with curative intent (eg, resected basal or squamous cell skin cancer, superficial bladder cancer, or carcinoma in situ of the cervix or breast).
rules.notes: Exceptions: current study cancer and locally recurring cancers treated with curative intent (includes resected basal/squamous cell skin cancer, superficial bladder cancer, carcinoma in situ of cervix or breast)

rules.rule_text: Uncontrolled diabetes
rules.source_text: Uncontrolled diabetes.

rules.rule_text: Infection requiring systemic antibacterial, antifungal, or antiviral therapy ≤ 28 days before first dose
rules.source_text: Infection requiring systemic antibacterial, antifungal, or antiviral therapy ≤ 28 days before the first dose of study drug(s), or symptomatic COVID-19 infection.

rules.rule_text: Symptomatic COVID-19 infection
rules.source_text: Infection requiring systemic antibacterial, antifungal, or antiviral therapy ≤ 28 days before the first dose of study drug(s), or symptomatic COVID-19 infection.

rules.rule_text: Untreated chronic hepatitis B or HBV carrier with HBV DNA ≥ 500 IU/mL (or ≥ 2500 copies/mL)
rules.source_text: Participants with untreated chronic hepatitis B or chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) carriers with HBV DNA ≥ 500 IU/mL (or ≥ 2500 copies/mL) at screening.
rules.notes: Measured at screening; threshold: HBV DNA ≥ 500 IU/mL or ≥ 2500 copies/mL

rules.rule_text: Active hepatitis C infection
rules.source_text: Participants with active hepatitis C infection.

rules.rule_text: Prior allogeneic stem cell transplantation
rules.source_text: Prior allogeneic stem cell transplantation, or organ transplantation.

rules.rule_text: Prior organ transplantation
rules.source_text: Prior allogeneic stem cell transplantation, or organ transplantation.
